changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbeds AS SELECT b.id, b.room_id, b.name, b.location_details, b.type, b.status, b.created_date, b.is_active, b.created_by, b.last_modified_by, b.last_modified_date FROM public.beds b;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbeds TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbeds FROM report_user;
